data.action: 从容端坐在秘密审讯室金属转椅上，黑白战术紧身衣前置拉链半开，修长双腿优雅交叠，冷艳蓝瞳与耳麦在战术顶灯下从容凝视
data.camera: cowboy shot, sitting on chair, slightly low angle, cinematic lighting
data.description: 模拟反审讯演练结束后的汇报室内，时从容端坐在单人金属椅中央。专属的黑白战术紧身衣前置拉链滑开至胸下透气，展现出紧致曼妙的腰身与白皙锁骨。修长双腿利落交叠，单手轻扶耳麦，标志性的双同心圆光环静谧悬浮，清澈冷冽的深蓝眼眸注视着眼前记录者，散发着顶级特工兼具无口反差的迷人魅力。
data.promptProse: Seated with cool poise on a metal swivel chair inside a dimly lit interrogation room, Toki crosses her long legs in her high-leg black-and-white combat suit, its front zipper lowered to mid-chest to show her collarbone and cleavage. An overhead tactical spotlight and cool blue rim light frame her earpiece and calm gaze.
data.title: 飞鸟马时 · 秘密审讯室的伪装
data.animaCaption: She sits composed with crossed legs and an unzipped combat suit in the interrogation room.
